title: Neural Machine Translation by Jointly Learning to Align and Translate
authors: D. Bahdanau, K. Cho, Y. Bengio
before: Seq2seq squeezed an entire source sentence into one fixed-length vector.
problem: That vector is a bottleneck. Translation quality collapsed on long sentences.
breakthrough: Let the decoder look back over all encoder states and weight them by relevance at each output step.
why: Attention starts here, not in 2017. The Transformer generalised this mechanism rather than inventing it.
next: Luong's variants, then the Transformer, which kept attention and threw away the recurrence.
inherits: The core operation of every model in use today: a learned, weighted look over other positions.
